newsitem.title: USA: TWA to acquire new Boeing 767-300.
newsitem.headline: TWA to acquire new Boeing 767-300.

text.p: Trans World Airlines Inc said it agreed to acquire a new Boeing Co 767-300 aircraft to be powered by two engines made by the Pratt & Whitney unit of United Technologies Corp.
Delivery is scheduled for February 1998, said the airline.
The aircraft will be TWA's fifteenth 767 and its third in the long-range 300 series, it said.
The craft will be used on Middle Eastern routes and represents part of a $1-billion upgrade of the airline's 190-plane fleet.
The craft will be acquired through a leasing agreement with International Lease Finance Corp for undisclosed terms, the airline said.
